description:
causal.rs defines five aggregate types that are each nothing but u64 counters summed field-wise: FormulaWork (10 fields), ProductWork (16), RecursiveSearchWork, ShiftWork, SessionWork.

The duplication is already visible as a bug-shaped asymmetry: FormulaWork has a private add() that sums its fields, so formula_totals() reads 'totals.add(work)'. ProductWork has no impl at all, so product_totals() hand-sums all 16 fields inline. Same idea, two shapes, and the hand-sum silently drops any field a future author forgets to add there.

Fold them into one summable mechanism so adding a counter cannot desync a totals function from its struct. Types rank highest in the fold rule.

Guard against conflating lookalikes: confirm all five really are pure field-wise-summable counter bags before merging, and keep any that carries a non-additive field distinct.
title: Fold the five causal *Work counter bags into one summable shape
